async def act(page):
    # Search for the product 'Gobi HeatTec Tee' by filling the search textbox and pressing Enter
    search_group = page.get_by_role("group", name="Search")
    search_textbox = search_group.get_by_role("textbox")
    await search_textbox.fill("Gobi HeatTec Tee")
    await search_textbox.press("Enter")  # Press Enter to trigger search
    
    # Wait for the page to update after search
    await page.wait_for_timeout(5000)  # Increased timeout to ensure search results load
    
    # Find the row for 'Gobi HeatTec Tee' and click the Edit link
    # Use filter to locate the correct row by product name
    product_row = page.get_by_role("row").filter(has=page.get_by_text("Gobi HeatTec Tee", exact=False))
    edit_link = product_row.get_by_role("link", name="Edit")
    await edit_link.click()
    
    # Wait for navigation to the edit page
    await page.wait_for_timeout(5000)
    
    # Click the Inventory link to access inventory settings
    inventory_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="Inventory")
    await inventory_link.click()
    await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)  # Wait for UI to update
    
    # Locate the stock status combobox and select 'Out of Stock'
    # Assuming the combobox appears with name 'Stock Status' after clicking Inventory
    stock_status_combobox = page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Stock Status")
    await stock_status_combobox.select_option("Out of Stock")
    
    # Save the changes
    save_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Save")
    await save_button.click()
    
    # Wait for save to complete
    await page.wait_for_timeout(3000)
